tasks.title: Bootstrap public FRWD repo (Apache-2.0, workspace, toolchain, CI)
tasks.description: Wire the existing empty GitHub repo github.com/Entract/FRWD to this working copy and land the project definition as the first commit. Includes: Apache-2.0 LICENSE (canonical text) and NOTICE; strong public README.md; .gitignore (ignoring volatile Alepou machinery under plan/ but tracking plan/docs/); pnpm workspace (pnpm-workspace.yaml + packageManager field); TypeScript base config; Vitest config; Playwright config and browser-test skeleton; GitHub Actions CI running typecheck + unit tests; empty package/app/fixture/test directory scaffold; spec/ and docs/ placeholders with adr/. Also corrects 00_START_HERE.md sections 7-8, which wrongly place the design pack at docs/design/ and ADRs at /docs/adr/ - plan/docs/ is the authoritative home for the design pack.

tasks.title: packages/format - parse, serialize and stable object identity
tasks.description: Framework-agnostic TypeScript package that reads and writes a .frwd document as semantic HTML. Provides: document parse into an in-memory view, stable data-frwd-id assignment and preservation, metadata block read/write, CSS/theme and embedded asset handling, deterministic serialization. Acceptance is semantic round-trip stability: a no-op open/save preserves document identity, all stable ids, semantic structure, content, CSS, metadata and embedded assets. Serialization must be deterministic (same input produces same bytes), but exact original whitespace and attribute formatting are NOT format invariants. No editor or UI framework dependencies.

tasks.title: fixtures/minimal + conformance harness
tasks.description: Land the minimal reference fixture and the conformance test harness that runs fixtures against packages/format. The harness must assert semantic round-trip stability and deterministic serialization, and be structured so new fixtures are cheap to add. This lands before sanitize/operations per the design pack instruction to write conformance fixtures early.

tasks.title: packages/sanitize - enforce the native no-script profile
tasks.description: Framework-agnostic sanitizer enforcing the native .frwd profile: no arbitrary executable JavaScript, no event-handler attributes, no external script or unsafe URL schemes, allow-list of elements/attributes/CSS consistent with the security document. Includes security test fixtures for known injection vectors. Must be usable both on import (untrusted document) and on export. Inspection and mutation stay strictly separate, matching the format package's reading-never-mutates principle: inspect() reports profile violations over an untrusted document without changing a byte of it, and sanitize() is an explicit, separately invoked repair that reports every change it makes. An unsafe file must be parseable as inert data and describable, never silently edited. Sanitize emits Diagnostic values in the same shape packages/format uses, and this task must also introduce the composed conformance result: a structurally valid FRWD that contains arbitrary executable script is NOT a conforming native FRWD, so the public answer to 'is this a conforming native document?' has to combine the structural layer and the safety profile rather than either alone.

tasks.title: packages/operations - deterministic semantic edit operations
tasks.description: The AI-native editing protocol as deterministic, testable operations over stable document objects: replace_text, replace_node, insert_before, insert_after, append_child, prepend_child, delete_node, move_node and set_attribute, addressed by data-frwd-id. No AI chat UI, no network, no model vendor dependency. Style and theme operations are deliberately deferred to t-016 so the structural core lands first. LOCKED TRANSACTION SEMANTICS: preview is strictly non-mutating; operations apply to a staged copy, never optimistically to the live tree with rollback; a failed transaction changes absolutely nothing; a successful one increments revision exactly once and updates modified exactly once; an absent manifest revision reads as 0; the staged final state must pass both structural and native safety-profile conformance before commit; unsafe generated content is rejected and reported, never silently sanitized; inserted and replacement structural nodes must end with valid unique stable ids, and no ambiguous target may be committed. replace_text is deliberately simple in v0.1: it replaces the target's complete child content with one escaped plain-text node and makes no attempt to preserve strong, links, citations or other inline markup; rich replacement uses replace_node, and range-aware editing is deferred.

tasks.title: packages/publisher + packages/runtime - .frwd.html emission
tasks.description: Publisher that emits report.frwd.html from a .frwd document, embedding the trusted standard FRWD browser runtime (edit mode hooks, safe rich interactivity, Save As, print/export helpers). The runtime is framework-agnostic and self-contained; the published file must be a single portable HTML file that works fully offline and remains readable with JavaScript disabled.

tasks.title: Cross-browser Playwright suite for .frwd.html
tasks.description: Exercise publisher output against Chromium, Firefox and WebKit as soon as the publisher exists - not after the editor. Covers: offline load from file:// with no network, JavaScript-disabled readability, media playback, print stylesheet rendering, and Save As round-trip back through packages/format. Wired into CI.

tasks.title: Designed reference fixtures (cv, scientific, business-report, rich-manual)
tasks.description: Build the designed reference documents as a first-class part of development, not merely as tests. These must demonstrate that FRWD produces exceptionally good-looking documents on screen and in print, and they drive requirements back into format, sanitize and publisher. Each fixture runs through the conformance harness and the cross-browser suite.

tasks.title: Public-facing docs: vision, architecture, ADR log, CONTRIBUTING
tasks.description: Write the public renditions that a visitor to the repo needs: docs/vision.md, docs/architecture.md, the first ADRs recording decisions already made (single-HTML source, no ZIP container, no arbitrary script in the native profile, toolchain), and a brief CONTRIBUTING.md. These are condensed public documents derived from the plan/docs/ design pack, not copies of it. Also define the conformance programme that TRADEMARKS.md defers, so that claims of FRWD compatibility have a published, testable standard behind them, and decide whether to promote the normative format spec into spec/FRWD-0.1.md at that point.

tasks.title: apps/editor - minimal flowing edit surface
tasks.description: Deliberately last. Choose the structured editing layer and UI framework only at this point, informed by what the format and operations work has taught us, and record the choice as an ADR. Vite is the build tool. Minimal scope: open a .frwd file, edit ordinary text naturally, insert a paragraph with correct reflow, move a media block, apply a restyle operation, export .frwd.html.

tasks.title: Correct copyright holder and split trademark policy into TRADEMARKS.md
tasks.description: Set the copyright line to 'Copyright 2026 Guy Monroe Entract'. Reduce NOTICE to actual copyright and attribution notices only, and move the FRWD name/logo policy into a dedicated root TRADEMARKS.md stating that Apache-2.0 licenses the code and specification but grants no rights to use the FRWD name or logo in a way implying official status, certification or endorsement, while factual statements that software implements FRWD are permitted. Update the references in README.md and 00_START_HERE.md. Lands before the first push so nothing incorrect is ever published.

tasks.title: Make document conformance reflect the current tree
tasks.description: FrwdDocument.diagnostics is captured once during parse, so it goes stale as soon as any method mutates the canonical tree - a document parsed with missing ids keeps reporting non-conforming after ensureIds() has fixed them. Replace the snapshot with a validate() method over the current tree and a diagnostics getter that calls it, so validation can never disagree with the document. Also remove the O(n-squared) scan for ids outside the document root, which is what would otherwise make a recomputing getter expensive, and raise missing-stable-id from warning to error: spec section 6 says an editable block MUST carry data-frwd-id, and grading a MUST as a warning was wrong. Regression test: a document with missing ids parses non-conforming, and becomes conforming after ensureIds().

tasks.title: Docs language pass: outward-facing README, durable non-goals
tasks.description: Remove conversational artefacts from the public-facing language without changing the format architecture. Rewrite README.md to be concise and outward-facing: what FRWD is, why it exists, the core architectural idea, status, and how to explore or contribute. Across the design pack, treat concrete document types (reports, CVs, manuals, papers) as examples rather than defining boundaries, and delete negatives that only make sense inside the design conversation - notably 'FRWD is not a CV maker, a presentation format, a web-page builder' and 'the CV is a useful demo, not the product definition'. Keep genuine architectural non-goals: slide or canvas layout, spreadsheet, macro or code execution environment, cloud-dependent workspace. FRWD_MASTER_DESIGN_SPEC.md consolidates the other documents and must be kept in step.

tasks.title: Normative doctype, and separate conformance from reference serialization
tasks.description: Two conformance-semantics corrections. First, the HTML5 doctype becomes normative: FRWD depends on predictable standards-mode rendering, so quirks mode is not conforming FRWD even though the content remains recoverable. Raise missing-doctype from warning to error, add the MUST to the format spec, and flip the missing-doctype fixture to non-conforming. Second, stop presenting the reference serializer's byte output as a conformance rule. Deterministic canonical output - attribute ordering, no trailing newline, no reindentation - is REFERENCE CANONICAL SERIALIZATION produced by @frwd/format, not a requirement on FRWD writers. A third-party writer may emit semantically equivalent valid FRWD without matching our bytes. The fixture corpus may require both where canonical is true, because it tests the reference implementation; external documents need only satisfy the semantic spec. Add a spec section stating the distinction and correct the wording in the package, fixtures and tests READMEs.

tasks.title: Harden the native safety profile: dataset type, fail-closed CSS, form/link surfaces
tasks.description: Three corrections to the profile. First, accept application/frwd-dataset+json as inert FRWD data - the rich-media spec section 7 defines datasets with that type, so the sanitizer currently rejects a construct FRWD 0.1 requires. Second, make css-parse-error an error rather than a warning: if the security layer cannot parse the CSS it cannot establish that the CSS makes no external requests, and the native profile must fail closed. Third, close user-triggered and network surfaces that native 0.1 gains nothing from: forbid <form> (forms are deferred and need an explicit future design and security model), forbid <link> (FRWD already owns its stylesheet in style#frwd-document-style, so an element that can pull in an uninspected stylesheet is pure attack surface), and reject the formaction and ping attributes. Add a focused regression fixture for each, plus a positive fixture proving an inert dataset block is accepted.

tasks.title: Style and theme operations
tasks.description: The design half of the AI editing protocol, deliberately split from t-005 so the structural core lands first. Covers set_theme_token, set_layout_variant, set_figure_variant and replace-stylesheet-region, all subject to CSS sanitization, plus the style-lock constraint applied to real CSS mutation rather than only to class and style attributes. Depends on t-005 for the transaction machinery: staging, atomicity, revision handling and composed conformance are already settled there and must not be reimplemented.
